mapper.sql: id, config_key, config_value, config_group, description, is_sensitive, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM system_config WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY config_group ASC, config_key ASC
SELECT FROM system_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM system_config WHERE config_group = #{configGroup} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY config_key ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_config (id, config_key, config_value, config_group, description, is_sensitive, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{configGroup}, #{description}, #{isSensitive}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE system_config SET config_value = #{configValue}, description = #{description}, is_sensitive = #{isSensitive}, update_time = NOW() WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE system_config SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
